To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a universal algorithm for sequential compression is presented; (2) its performance is analyzed with respect to a model of constrained sources; (3) the compression ratio attained by the proposed code is within a factor of two of the best possible compression ratio; (4) the algorithm can be used for sequential compression of any source; and (5) the algorithm can also be used for sequential decompression.

(a) a simple algorithm can be used to achieve the best compression ratios possible with a fixed amount of information about the statistics of the source; and (b) the compression ratio of a code designed for one source can be made arbitrarily close to the optimal compression ratio achievable with a code designed for a different source by increasing the amount of information about that source.
(1) The proposed universal algorithm is a universal algorithm for sequential source coding.
